laws.rule: Great Walk huts must be booked in advance on DOC's booking system; international visitors pay higher summer rates (October to April) and DOC staff run random checks at huts. Milford Track: international adult NZD 152 a hut night in summer (about A$122, RBA rate of 30 October 2026); independent walkers need three consecutive nights. Kepler Track: NZD 132. Rakiura Track: NZD 66.

local-law.note: Fiordland's Milford and Kepler Tracks, and Rakiura (Stewart Island).

layers.process: Milford Track (Fiordland National Park): in the Great Walks season (1 November 2026 to 30 April 2027, last departure 28 April 2027) huts and transport must be booked. The track can only be walked in one direction, over 3 nights and 4 days. Camping is not permitted on the track. Outside the season (1 May to 31 October) facilities are greatly reduced and DOC says only fit, experienced people with alpine, river-crossing and navigation skills should attempt it. No dogs.

layers.authority: Department of Conservation Te Papa Atawhai
layers.process: Kepler Track: DOC lists the Great Walks season as 27 October 2026 to 30 April 2027 and requires hut and campsite bookings in that season. Outside the season facilities and booking rules differ, and DOC says the route needs alpine, river-crossing and navigation experience.

layers.authority: Department of Conservation Te Papa Atawhai
layers.process: Rakiura Track on Rakiura / Stewart Island: DOC says all huts and campsites must be booked in advance throughout the year. Check access and track notices with DOC before travel.

layers.authority: Department of Conservation Te Papa Atawhai
layers.process: Hump Ridge Track: bookings are handled by the Hump Ridge Trust, rather than the DOC Great Walk booking system. DOC says the track requires fitness for 7 to 9 hours walking per day with significant elevation gain. Check the operator for current availability and conditions.
